listing.name: TARGET: Terror (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed Windows setup for the NTSC-U Wii disc.

steps.title: Prepare your Wii disc image
steps.instruction: In an already permitted Windows x64 copy, keep the runtime DLLs beside targetterror.exe. Supply your own NTSC-U RGDEA4 ISO or CISO in that writable folder.

steps.title: Allow space for the upstream import
steps.instruction: Run targetterror.exe and allow first-run extraction to populate game. Keep the original disc image separately, and leave enough free space for the generated files.

steps.title: Preserve the creating profile
steps.instruction: Keep the generated game folder, targetterror.ini and nand, including high scores, with the creating runtime.

warnings: Use an already permitted copy. The published license for the upstream project has its own scope, and the package contains translated title code. Fresh acquisition needs attributable permission for that code or a separately reviewed preparation route.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh Portcove downloads are held because the selected TARGET: Terror executable contains translated title code and the published project license does not establish permission for that separate component. Resume with an attributable applicable grant or a reviewed package or preparation route that resolves it. Independently permitted copies retain their own setup route.
